title: Holding and Resuming New Placements under the Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
New placements under an agreement of the Contingency Placement Agreements are held for one of two reasons, and the reason is recorded on the agreement as the placement hold reason: fees past due, or a client-requested pause.

## Fees past due

- Placements are held for fees past due only when the handling date is later than the past-due limit counted from the invoice date of the oldest unpaid invoice.
- The past-due limit is the invoice date plus the tier's fee-invoice due days in calendar days plus the tier's past-due days before a hold, in calendar days.
- The invoice date is read from the agreement's client money history. The comparison is strict: the limit day itself does not satisfy it; the day after does.
- A fees-past-due hold is lifted when every invoice past its due date is paid or credited.

## Client-requested pause

- Placements are held for a client-requested pause when the client asks to pause new placements through a placement pause service request.
- The pause lasts no longer than the tier's maximum pause in calendar days, after which the client must resume or give termination notice.
- A client-requested pause is lifted on the client's placement resume request.

## What a hold does not stop

A hold never stops Ridgeline from working, collecting on, remitting for or reporting accounts already placed.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

Under a tier with 15 fee-invoice due days and 45 past-due days before a hold, the past-due limit of the oldest unpaid invoice falls 60 calendar days after its invoice date.

| Handling date | Later than the past-due limit? | Fees-past-due hold may be placed? |
|---|---|---|
| 59 days after the invoice date | no | no |
| 60 days after the invoice date (the limit itself) | no | no |
| 61 days after the invoice date | yes | yes |

| Hold reason | Lifted when |
|---|---|
| Fees past due | every invoice past its due date is paid or credited |
| Client-requested pause | the client makes a placement resume request |
